The corpus mirror (corpus/ade/mirror) with its `iref_node` label taken out
of gen_mirror.py, extracted by magic from the toolchain the way
layoutlib.run_magic_extract(parasitics=True) runs it, and kept as magic
wrote them (before uncount_rnode_caps and lost_couplings):

- `unlabelled.*`: with the net naming pass off - the net comes back as
  magic's `a_38_n132#`, and extresist drops its coupling to iout and its
  lumped C (a planted fault for lost_couplings).
- `named.*`: as the engine runs it, the net labelled `a_38_n132` first -
  every coupling kept, and its rnode C (`named.res.ext`, 94.35 aF, the
  same as its coupling to iout) written to vss a second time.
